tasks.answer: FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen (exportName FlightDelayCompensationBatchScreen), feature layer, import from @/features/flight-delay-compensation/batch-detail-screen. Required prop: batchId. It is the batch compensation workspace covering standard, special and review steps; it needs query, auth and router providers and handles offline/conflict states.

The catalog has no dedicated 'special traveler booking list' variant; the only matching booking-list entry is the generic paginated traveler booking list: bookings.TravelerBookingListScreen (@/features/traveler-bookings/booking-list-screen), required prop navigate (initialStatus optional), with search and filters and permission-gated queries/actions. A special-traveler-specific variant does not exist in the catalog.

auth.PasswordInput (exportName PasswordInput) from @/features/auth/password-input; no required props. It must be used inside UiFormField: the error is displayed as a string by the field wrapper (not by the input itself); the component provides show/hide labels plus a form-field error.

Search bar: business.SearchBar (@/components/business/mobile) — required props value, placeholder, onChange; optional onFilter adds the filter icon button. Filter panel: business.FilterSheet (@/components/business/mobile) — required props visible, title, children, onClose; onConfirm runs before the sheet closes. Both are shared-ui mobile business components.

common.AuthRecoveryDialog (@/components/common/auth-recovery-dialog), no required props. It is a global dialog that subscribes to the auth recovery store and lazily renders its view; mount it once near the app root (e.g., in the root layout/app shell). It renders null while no recovery event is pending. The separate AuthRecoveryDialogView is the internal view driven by detail.state.
